commit.message: feat(helm): migrate terminal chassis to Ink 7

intent: Migrate the Helm product chassis from Ink 5 to Ink 7 with React 19.2 and Node 22, wiring alternate-screen and window-size ownership once at the app root, preserving navigation/overlay boundaries, and deliberately re-golding the 42 compact/standard/panorama frames once after real tmux verification.

negative_controls.command: python3 -c "import pathlib,sys; p=pathlib.Path('terminal/src/index.tsx'); t=p.read_text(); old='alternateScreen: true'; new='alternateScreen: false'; (t.count(old) == 1) or sys.exit(3); p.write_text(t.replace(old,new,1)); sys.exit(1 if 'alternateScreen: false' in p.read_text() else 2)"
negative_controls.name: alternate-screen-removal-is-observable

honest_blockers: The shared Node 22 CI pin is owned by repository-titanium-hardening and is carried separately in draft PR #1422; this terminal packet does not cross that ownership boundary.
This ticket upgrades the chassis and rendering primitives only. It does not itself create seven fresh live route receipts or satisfy the Helm alive bar.
interface_mismatches: Ink 7 requires Node >=22 and React >=19.2 while the terminal manifest and CI pin Ink 5, React 18, and Node 20.
The current app owns width through global process.stdout and a manual resize tick; Ink 7 provides renderer-owned useWindowSize.
Golden capture sends Escape and Tab without waiting for Ink 7 escape-sequence disambiguation.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the packet-scoped migration commit to restore Ink 5/React 18/Node 20 and the previous 42 golden frames.
